pages.text: $(thing)Snares$() are passive small-creature traps. They can capture mobs that walk into them directly, or passively attract and catch wildlife over time when baited.
Crafted from sticks, lumber, and jute fiber.

pages.title: Bait
pages.text: Right-click a snare with $(thing)grain$() or $(thing)seeds$() to insert bait. Bait is required for passive catches.$(br2)Shift-right-click an empty snare to remove bait without triggering it.

pages.title: Passive Catch
pages.text: A baited snare checks periodically for a catch. Only animals that $(thing)naturally spawn in the local biome$() can be passively caught — exotic creatures from other climates will not appear.$(br2)Bait is consumed on a successful passive catch.

pages.title: Handling Captures
pages.text: Shift-right-click a triggered snare to release and reset it.$(br2)If the snare block is broken, the captured entity is released.
